Class BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.publisher.BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogEventLogger, LogLifecycle, LogPublisher, LogPublisher.AsyncLogPublisher, AutoCloseable
public final class BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisher extends Object implements LogPublisher.AsyncLogPublisher
The default bounded async publisher with one output worker. Producers block when the pending buffer is full. Events are delivered in insertion order, including calls already waiting for space when shutdown begins. New calls are rejected during shutdown. Select it explicitly with the "batchswap" URI scheme to keep using it if the default async implementation changes.

Up to bufferSize events may wait for delivery while another batch of up to that size is being written. The queued metric excludes the batch currently being written. Events passed directly to log(LogEvent) must already be frozen, as required by async publishers.

Closing waits for the configured timeout without interrupting output operations. If it times out, an error alert is recorded and the worker continues draining before closing the appender. Logging recursively from the worker is rejected to prevent deadlock. Rejected events increment LogMetrics.EVENTS_DROPPED_METRIC, with one error alert per rejection reason for each publisher. An interrupted producer can enqueue when space is available; interruption while waiting for space drops the event and preserves the interrupt flag.

    • builder

      public static BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder builder(String name)
      Creates a named builder. Call BatchSwapAsyncLogPublisherBuilder.fromProperties(LogProperties) to read logging.publisher.<name>.bufferSize and logging.publisher.<name>.shutdownTimeout. Properties override builder values when present. Select its factory with LogRouter.Router.Builder.publisher(LogPublisher.PublisherFactory).
